articles.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
articles.content: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
articles.titleZh: Grok Build编码代理泄露了一些机密信息，其中一些属于SpaceXSI
articles.contentZh: 研究人员发现， 35,000个Grok Build应用程序向所有寻找它们的人开放。

articles.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
articles.content: "*sshole" poses a serious threat to Internet security.
articles.titleZh: 允许黑客SSH进入Linux设备的漏洞正在被主动利用
articles.contentZh: “* sshole”对互联网安全构成严重威胁。

articles.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
articles.content: Company said a "multifront cyberattack" included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.
articles.titleZh: Chainalysis称黑客窃取了其所有客户的凭据和令牌
articles.contentZh: 该公司表示， “多前线网络攻击”包括人工智能代理和路径数据抢夺。

articles.title: Meet *sshole, the vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices
articles.content: Certain configurations of Alpine are affected. Other distros may be as well.
articles.titleZh: 满足* sshole ，让黑客SSH进入Linux设备的漏洞
articles.contentZh: Alpine的某些配置受到影响。其他发行版也可能如此。

articles.title: Microsoft’s DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode
articles.content: Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today. Auto SR is also getting some new features alongside this official release. In April, Microsoft started testing Auto SR […]

articles.title: The VR Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now has 3D movies
articles.content: Disney is bringing more than 60 3D movies to the Disney Plus app on Meta Quest. The movies will be available to Disney Plus subscribers as part of an updated Disney Plus app that's rolling out today.
